title: Friday and Weekend Loading on Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Replenishment Debits
content:
**Clause.** A replenishment debit on a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service pulled on a Friday adds 20 percent and one pulled on a Saturday or Sunday adds 10 percent, because instant payouts continue while the debit waits for the next business day to settle; a debit pulled on any other day adds nothing for the weekend.

| Day the debit is pulled | Weekend loading |
|---|---|
| Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday | nothing |
| Friday | 20 percent |
| Saturday or Sunday | 10 percent |

The day is the calendar day on which the debit is pulled and booked.
